name: Piston Automotive
old_description: We believe in the process, and it’s the quality of that process that makes all the difference. Our expertise in assembly systems creates unrivaled value for our customers. Our process-driven approach not only makes better builds, it builds better value.
about:
Piston Automotive operates from Marion, Ohio, where it was founded by former NBA player Vinnie Johnson. The company's founding year is not publicly disclosed, but its history emphasizes a tradition of growth and expansion across multiple locations. Johnson established the business with a focus on assembly systems, building a culture that sweats the details and honors every promise.

The company provides advanced assembly and manufacturing services backed by process engineering, design and development, and product design and prototype testing. Its capabilities span vehicle systems including electrical and battery, powertrain and cooling, interior, exterior, and chassis. Piston Automotive also offers total solution and supply chain management, handling customer requirements analysis, assembly process conceptualization, design verification, product-level testing, and production validation trials. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

Piston Automotive serves the automotive industry, working with industry-leading manufacturers on vehicle electrification and traditional powertrain programs. Its customer base includes OEMs and tier suppliers seeking a partner for complex assembly and process-driven solutions across multiple vehicle platforms.

The company differentiates itself through a process-driven philosophy summarized as "Our process is our product." It claims a national reputation for product and process excellence, positioning itself as a partner rather than a supplier, adding value at every stage from concept through production. Continuous improvement in knowledge, capabilities, and quality is stated as a core commitment.
